pt.title: Contas a pagar
pt.body: Detecta boletos e faturas nos e-mails (corpo e PDF), extrai emissor, valor e vencimento por regex, lança na planilha e lembra 3 dias antes e no dia. Nunca paga nada. Aguarda teste real.

en.title: Bills payable
en.impact: Bills do not slip past their due date.
en.body: Detects bills and invoices in email (body and PDF), extracts issuer, amount and due date by regex, logs them in the spreadsheet and reminds 3 days before and on the day. It never pays anything. Real-world testing is pending.
